entry.title: New: RES26-277 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
URGING THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH TO CONTINUE TO INVESTIGATE THE PUBLIC HEALTH AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS OF THE SEPTEMBER 2026 WAIAWA, PEARL CITY, JUNKYARD FIRE AND COORDINATE WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL TO ENFORCE APPLICABLE LAWS.

Latest action: Introduced.
